evals.prompt: 帮我查一下 2026 年新能源汽车购置税减免的最新政策，要政府网站的原文，并告诉我发布日期
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the DeepSeek search CLI, prefers a gov.cn/miit.gov.cn result, quotes the policy name and publication date, and cites the URL. It does not rely on portal reposts.

evals.prompt: Find the official vLLM documentation for automatic prefix caching. I only want the canonical English docs, not translated copies or mirrors.
evals.expected_output: Agent adds --lang en --drop-localized and/or --site docs.vllm.ai, returns the docs.vllm.ai page, and avoids localized editions or mintlify.wiki clones.

evals.prompt: Read this page and summarize the method: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762
evals.expected_output: Agent calls fetch on the URL, summarizes the abstract, and does not quote code blocks or tables as if they were preserved. It may note that the extractor flattens formatting.

evals.prompt: Read https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools and tell me what the web search tool costs.
evals.expected_output: Agent attempts fetch, receives HTTP 404 (no extractable content), explains the limitation, and falls back to search --content or another extractor instead of fabricating page content.

evals.prompt: DeepSeek 今天发布了什么？只要今天的消息
evals.expected_output: Agent searches with a recency constraint (after: or --after), checks result dates, and distinguishes today's release from older coverage.

evals.prompt: Search for pgvector HNSW tuning advice and give me a table of source, title, and URL that I can process with a script.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs search with --json, parses the api_response.results array, and builds a table from title/url fields without scraping the human-readable output.

evals.prompt: 帮我找 OpenAI GPT-6 的官方发布说明，不要二手媒体的转述
evals.expected_output: Agent runs search, notices quality.warning (or the stderr warning) that no official host is present, and retries with --site openai.com or --official-only followed by --site. It returns help.openai.com or openai.com, not Yahoo/Digit/RRI.

evals.prompt: 北京公积金贷款额度现在是多少？要政府原文
evals.expected_output: Agent uses --official-only or --site gjj.beijing.gov.cn, quotes the government page, and ignores the raw-IP and portal results.
